title: What happens if you shelter under a manchineel tree in the rain?

lines.text: This is the most dangerous tree on Earth. And you just hid under it.
You're on holiday in the Caribbean. Perfect beach. And a tree full of little green apples.
You take a bite. It's sweet... for about ten seconds.
Then it's pepper. Then it's fire. Your throat swells so tight you can barely swallow.
Then a storm rolls in. And the only shelter on the beach is... the same tree.
Every raindrop washes milky sap off its leaves and onto you. Wherever it lands, your skin blisters.

lines.speaker: ranger
lines.text: Hey! Not that tree! Didn't you see the red band?
Locals paint red bands on these trunks. Even its smoke can blind you.
Spanish sailors called it the little apple of death. Legend says an arrow dipped in its sap killed the explorer Ponce de Leon.
And yet one animal eats them like candy.
The black spiny-tailed iguana even lives in its branches.
That bite really happened, to a British doctor in Tobago. She survived, and warned the world in a medical journal.
Comment what you want to know next.

experiment.note: Remake of 012 in the new fast-cut 3D set style (Ricks Clips direction): storm beach set, detailed animated sea, cut every ~2 s, dramatic cameras, character lines in other voices, Qwen3-TTS voices.

facts.claim: Guinness World Records lists the manchineel as the world's most dangerous tree

Radiologist Nicola Strickland ate a manchineel 'beach apple' on Tobago: pleasantly sweet, then peppery, then burning and a throat so tight she could barely swallow; she recovered and reported it in the BMJ
Standing under the tree in rain blisters skin because rain carries the milky sap; burning it can injure eyes; trees are often marked with a red band or X
Spanish name manzanilla de la muerte, 'little apple of death'
Popular accounts say Ponce de Leon died in 1521 from a Calusa arrow tipped with manchineel sap (belief, not documented fact: told as 'legend says')
The black spiny-tailed iguana (Ctenosaura similis) eats manchineel fruit and lives among its limbs

qwen_instruct.narrator: Energetic, punchy viral storyteller, fast and dramatic with a hint of amusement.
qwen_instruct.ranger: Shouting in alarm from a distance, urgent and loud.
qwen_instruct.iguana: Very slow, deep and smug, savouring the word.
